title: Full Data Import & Migration Release Gate

rcDeltaFromDev2.scope: version/release labeling + archived RC build only

manualReleaseChecks: From an existing/local SalaryMate browser, export a full-history JSON.
Open the RC Pages candidate in a different browser/origin.
Select the JSON and verify pre-import record counts.
Apply import and confirm reload completes.
Verify overtime, attendance, snapshots, payslips, additions, annual data and company settings.
Close and reopen the browser/page and confirm data persists.
Export again from the migrated browser and confirm a valid JSON is produced.
Optional failure test: use invalid JSON and verify no existing data changes.
